ai.title: AI integration (MCP)
ai.lead:
MOJIOKO connects to AI via MCP, so an assistant can drive it for you.
Just ask Claude to transcribe, translate, or burn subtitles into a video.
Everything runs locally on this PC.
ai.step1: Export the MCP config (or copy it).
ai.step2: Add its contents to Claude Desktop under Settings > Extensions (or the config file).
ai.step4: Then just ask Claude, e.g. "add subtitles to this video".
ai.codeDesc: Run this command in your terminal to register the server.
ai.clientsNote: Supported clients: Claude Desktop and Claude Code (not claude.ai / Cowork).

translation.hint: Auto-translate cues in the inspector (preview only — never written to the subtitles). Get the translation tool from STEP 1 → Translation tool.
translation.needTool: No translation tool downloaded. Download one from STEP 1 → Translation tool to enable these settings.

fonts.hint: Click a font to set it as the default. Adding and downloading fonts is a paid-version feature.

defaultStyle.hint: Sets the default subtitle style. These values are applied at transcription time.

shortcuts.hint: Read-only reference for the currently assigned keyboard shortcuts.
shortcuts.groupEditorDesc: Active when no dialog / drawer is open and focus is outside any text input.
shortcuts.groupTimelineDesc: Active only while the timeline view is on screen. In the list view arrow keys revert to native focus navigation.
shortcuts.groupOverlay: While a dialog / drawer is open
shortcuts.groupOverlayDesc: Every dialog and drawer (settings, add row, time editor, color picker, burn-in, etc.) closes on Esc. The color picker also accepts Enter as OK.

about.developedBy: This app was developed by BrightRyo.
